nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route exposing GET and POST handlers to list and create creator workflows in Supabase with a dev-mode auth bypass for local development.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists creator workflows for the authenticated (or dev-bypass) user from Supabase.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new creator workflow record with validated input and writes it via the Supabase service client.

nodes.name: getDevUserId
nodes.summary: Resolves the current Supabase auth user id, falling back to a fixed dev-bypass UUID when auth fails.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Expand-mode endpoint that takes a creator concept and runs the full prediction pipeline with creator context to produce a deep concept score response.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates input, resolves the creator context, invokes runPredictionPipeline in expand mode, and returns the full prediction payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight concept-score endpoint using the rule-based concept-scorer with creator context, exposing POST for scoring and GET for history retrieval.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Scores a candidate concept against the creator profile using the concept-scorer module and persists the result.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns recent concept-score records for the authenticated creator.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Endpoint that returns the list of creator profiles known to the system for selection UIs.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the list of creators from Supabase, ordered for selection menus.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Creator onboarding endpoint that ingests profile + reference videos and triggers immediate video analysis to build a baseline creator context.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Validates onboarding payload, persists creator + reference videos, and launches the immediate video analyzer to populate baseline metrics.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns current onboarding status for the requesting creator.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Returns and creates per-creator prediction run records used by the creator dashboard.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns recent prediction runs for the creator, ordered by timestamp.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Persists a new prediction run record for the creator from the supplied payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Creator-side prediction endpoint that loads creator context, downloads source video, runs the full prediction pipeline, and schedules post-publish metric collection.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Authenticated endpoint that resolves creator context, downloads the TikTok source, assembles context, runs runPredictionPipeline with personalization, and schedules metric collection.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Health-check / latest-prediction summary handler used to verify endpoint availability.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Thin endpoint that returns the current creator's profile via the profile_builder library.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the assembled creator profile from profile_builder.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: POST endpoint that triggers a rebuild of the creator profile via the profile_builder library.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cron handler that finds unacknowledged briefs and emits auto-nudge events through the account-manager auto-nudge module.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Iterates unacknowledged briefs, applies nudge policy, and emits events via the platform event bus.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Autodream cron route that generates briefs per agency, classifies priorities, and runs adversarial evaluation over assembled context.

nodes.name: generateBriefs
nodes.summary: Generates a set of candidate briefs for the agency from assembled context and LLM output.

nodes.name: classifyPriority
nodes.summary: Classifies the priority bucket of a generated brief based on heuristics.

nodes.name: processAgency
nodes.summary: Runs the full autodream cycle for one agency: gather context, generate briefs, score adversarially, and persist results.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Cron entry point that iterates active agencies and invokes processAgency for each.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cron route that scans recent platform events and classifies them into trend buckets for downstream analytics.

nodes.name: classifyTrends
nodes.summary: Applies heuristic + model-based classification to a batch of recent events, returning trend tags.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Cron handler that fetches recent events, runs classifyTrends, and persists classifications.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Memory consolidation cron that summarizes facts per agency via an LLM, applies cold demotion rules, and logs consolidation runs.

nodes.name: runConsolidationLLM
nodes.summary: Calls the consolidation LLM with the agency's facts payload and parses structured output.

nodes.name: consolidateAgency
nodes.summary: Runs the full consolidation cycle for a single agency including token budgeting, LLM call, and writing demoted/promoted facts.

nodes.name: applyColdDemotionRules
nodes.summary: Applies heuristic cold-demotion rules to facts that no longer meet recency or relevance thresholds.

nodes.name: logConsolidation
nodes.summary: Writes consolidation run telemetry to the platform_events log for later audit.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Cron entry point that iterates active agencies and runs consolidateAgency for each.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cultural-scan cron that pulls signals from Reddit and Twitter per niche, extracts themes, and synthesizes trend records for the trend store.

nodes.name: fetchSubredditTop
nodes.summary: Fetches the top posts from a given subreddit using Reddit's public API.

nodes.name: extractThemes
nodes.summary: Extracts candidate themes from a batch of social posts using keyword/topic heuristics.

nodes.name: scanReddit
nodes.summary: Drives the Reddit pass: pulls subreddit feeds for each niche, throttles requests, and collects raw posts.

nodes.name: scanTwitterForNiche
nodes.summary: Queries Twitter for a niche's keywords and returns normalized posts.

nodes.name: scanTwitter
nodes.summary: Drives the Twitter pass across niches, aggregating results from scanTwitterForNiche.

nodes.name: synthesizeTrends
nodes.summary: Combines extracted themes from Reddit and Twitter into a unified trend record per niche with confidence scoring and dedupe.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Cron entry point that orchestrates Reddit + Twitter scans and writes the synthesized trend records.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cron route that triggers the analytics discovery module to generate content recipes from recent platform signals.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Invokes analytics discovery to generate recipes and returns a small status payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cron route that runs the overnight-triage workflow to prioritize follow-ups and surface stalled items.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Delegates to the overnight-triage module and returns a structured summary of triaged items.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cron route that drains the scheduler queue by invoking the scheduler processor with a service-role Supabase client.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Shared GET/POST handler that invokes the scheduler processor and serializes results.

nodes.name: getServiceDb
nodes.summary: Returns a Supabase client using the service-role key for cron-context operations.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Cron entry for the automated training pipeline: schedules backfills, scrapes creators, collects metrics, auto-labels, and runs Spearman evaluation steps.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Dispatches a training-pipeline step (or all steps) by invoking the relevant training modules based on the step query param.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Endpoint that returns cross-channel cascade data from the cross service.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns cross-channel cascade analytics via the cross service.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: POST endpoint that returns cross-channel predictions for a given seed via the cross service.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Reads payload, delegates to cross service, and returns the cross-channel prediction.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: GET endpoint returning a cross-channel summary view from the cross service.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated cross-channel summary via the cross service.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight endpoint for capturing customer-satisfaction (CSAT) responses into Supabase.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Persists a CSAT response payload to Supabase using a server-role client.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Data-explorer endpoint that computes quality metrics over the prediction_runs corpus including a DPS histogram for the dashboard.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Computes coverage, distribution, and quality metrics across prediction runs and returns them with a DPS histogram for the data-explorer UI.

nodes.name: calculateDPSHistogram
nodes.summary: Buckets DPS scores into a fixed-width histogram for visualization.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Data-explorer endpoint that returns paginated video records with filtering for the analytics UI.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns paginated, filterable video records from Supabase for the data-explorer dashboard.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Debug endpoint that proxies through to the templates/analytics route for development inspection.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the templates analytics payload as a debug passthrough.
